name: Gajar Ka Halwa
description: Rich Pakistani gajar ka halwa made by slowly cooking grated carrots with milk, sugar, cardamom and ghee until concentrated and glossy.
ingredients: 1 kg carrots, washed, peeled if needed and grated
method: Put the grated carrots and milk in a broad heavy-bottomed pan and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cook over moderate heat, stirring regularly, until the carrots are tender and most of the milk has reduced. Stir more frequently as the mixture thickens so the milk solids do not catch.
Add the sugar and crushed cardamom and continue cooking; the sugar will release additional moisture, so let that liquid reduce again.
Add the ghee and cook while stirring until the halwa looks glossy, concentrated and moist rather than watery.
Taste and stop reducing before the halwa becomes dry because it will firm slightly as it cools.
Garnish with chopped almonds and pistachios and serve warm, or cool and store appropriately for later serving.
